title: PrefPI: Preference-Guided Steering into Out-of-Distribution Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2609.40165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present PrefPI (Preference-Guided Policy Iteration), an iterative framework for steering pretrained generative robot policies using only relative preferences over self-generated trajectories. Unlike prior preference-learning methods that primarily sharpen modes already represented by the policy, we study steering beyond the initial effective support, where desired behaviors are rarely or never observed under the initial policy. Our key idea is to formulate preference learning as preference-conditioned generative modeling: preferred trajectories define a conditional distribution, whose density ratio with the broader behavior prior provides an implicit preference signal amplified by classifier-free guidance (CFG). Repeating this preference-conditioned modeling and guidance step yields a form of preference-guided policy iteration, turning incremental improvements toward previously inaccessible behaviors. translated_title: PrefPI：偏好引导转向分布外行为
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PrefPI（偏好引导策略迭代），这是一个迭代框架，仅使用对自生成轨迹的相对偏好来引导预训练的生成式机器人策略。与以往主要锐化策略中已有模式的偏好学习方法不同，我们研究的是超出初始有效支持范围的引导，即期望行为在初始策略下很少或从未被观察到的情况。我们的关键思想是将偏好学习形式化为偏好条件生成建模：被偏好的轨迹定义了一个条件分布，其与更广泛行为先验之间的密度比提供了一个隐式偏好信号，该信号可通过无分类器引导（CFG）进行放大。重复这一偏好条件建模和引导步骤，形成了一种偏好引导的策略迭代，将渐进式的改进积累为对先前无法实现行为的逐步逼近。（注：摘要原文在列举适用策略类型处被截断）
tldr: 提出PrefPI框架，将偏好学习转化为偏好条件生成建模，并通过无分类器引导（CFG）放大隐式偏好信号，实现迭代式引导预训练机器人策略掌握初始策略下从未观察到的分布外行为。
en_tdlr: PrefPI formulates preference learning as preference-conditioned generative modeling amplified by classifier-free guidance, enabling iterative steering of pretrained robot policies toward out-of-distribution behaviors rarely or never observed under the initial policy.
